commits.subject: fix: bound scheduled-task queue retention
commits.description: Limited finished background-task history to 5,000 successful runs with a 24-hour cleanup window and 1,000 failed runs with a seven-day cleanup window, and increased Redis's default memory allowance to 1 GiB. This prevents old scheduler records from exhausting memory and interrupting event attendance tracking. Operators also gain safer health and rollback checks. Discord commands and normal member interactions are unchanged.
